title: Expression evaluation
summary: Trace an arithmetic expression and reason about operator grouping.
statement: Fix the expression so it adds a and b before multiplying by c. Predict total for the selected input.

specification.input: Three space-separated integers a, b, and c.
specification.output: Print (a + b) multiplied by c, followed by a newline.
specification.constraints: Use integer arithmetic and keep the program as a single-file C++17 program.

checkpoints.question: What value is stored in total after this expression is evaluated?
